# Meta

Use `meta/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "meta-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "meta/muse-spark-1.1",
});
```

- `META_MODEL_API_KEY`

`@ai-sdk/openai`

## Default base URL

`https://api.meta.ai/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `META_BASE_URL`.
